## here we do the same analysis as for the first revision but investigate what happens if we additionally include a measures of whether subjects guessed the right drug condition together with heart rate varability and average heart rate across the task for both tasks.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse,posterior, bayesplot, tidybayes,grid,ez,
               lsmeans, brms,lmerTest,glmmTMB,sjPlot,ggeffects, patchwork, cowplot,ggpubr,flextable, ordinal)


source(here::here("scripts","plots.R"))

```

## HRD analysis
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
z_score = function(x){
  return((x - mean(x)) / sd(x))
}

hrd1 = read.csv(here::here("data","HRD_trial_level_data.csv"))


drugguess_data <- read_csv(here::here("data","drugguess_data.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(drugs = ifelse(ActualDrug == "plac","PLACEBO",ifelse(ActualDrug == "biso","BISO","PROP")),
         subject = paste0("sub_",SubNo)) %>% 
  mutate(SubNo = NULL)




data <- inner_join(hrd1,drugguess_data) %>%
  mutate(
    resp = ifelse(Decision == "More", 1, 0),
    condition = as.numeric(drugs),
    BISO_vs_PLACEBO = case_when(
      drugs == "PLACEBO" ~ 0,
      drugs == "BISO" ~ 1,
      drugs == "PROP" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Use NA_real_ for numeric NA
    ),
    PROP_vs_PLACEBO = case_when(
      drugs == "PLACEBO" ~ 0,
      drugs == "BISO" ~ 0,
      drugs == "PROP" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Use NA_real_ for numeric NA
    ),
    
  ) %>% 
  mutate(trials = 1:n()) %>% 
  mutate(prediction = ifelse(ActualDrug == GuessedDrug,1,0)) %>% 
  select(resp, drugs, subject, Alpha, trials, BISO_vs_PLACEBO,PROP_vs_PLACEBO,listenBPM,Confidence,ResponseCorrect,prediction) %>%
  # drop_na() %>%
  mutate(sub = as.numeric(as.factor(subject)))


```



## fit the psychometric function
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
# first two (bad data) last one due to unblinding

outliers_hrd = c("sub_4043","sub_4024","sub_4049")

mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("scripts","stanmodels","revisions","revisions_v2","HRD_final.stan"),stanc_options = list("O1"))

avg_hr = data %>% group_by(drugs,sub) %>% 
  summarise(avg_hr = mean(listenBPM),
            sd_hr = sd(listenBPM)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(avg_hr = z_score(avg_hr),
         sd_hr = z_score(sd_hr))

data = inner_join(avg_hr,data)

df1_nooutlier = data %>% filter(!subject %in% outliers_hrd) %>% 
  mutate(sub = as.numeric(as.factor(sub)))%>% 
  arrange(sub,drugs) %>% 
  group_by(sub,drugs) %>% 
  mutate(trials_per_id = 1:n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(full_trials = 1:n(), trials = NULL)

# write.csv(df1_nooutlier,here::here("data","cleaned","HRD.csv"))

datastan = list(T = nrow(df1_nooutlier),
                S = length(unique(df1_nooutlier$sub)),
                S_id = as.numeric(df1_nooutlier$sub),
                X = df1_nooutlier %>% .$Alpha,
                X_lapse = (as.matrix((data.frame(int = rep(1,nrow(df1_nooutlier)),
                                                 placebo_vs_biso = df1_nooutlier %>% .$BISO_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                 placebo_vs_prop = df1_nooutlier %>% .$PROP_vs_PLACEBO)))),
                
                X_alpha = (as.matrix((data.frame(int = rep(1,nrow(df1_nooutlier)),
                                                 placebo_vs_biso = df1_nooutlier %>% .$BISO_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                 placebo_vs_prop = df1_nooutlier %>% .$PROP_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                 avg_hr = df1_nooutlier %>% .$avg_hr,
                                                 sd_hr = df1_nooutlier$sd_hr
                                                 )))),
                
                X_beta = (as.matrix((data.frame(int = rep(1,nrow(df1_nooutlier)),
                                                placebo_vs_biso = df1_nooutlier %>% .$BISO_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                placebo_vs_prop = df1_nooutlier %>% .$PROP_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                avg_hr = df1_nooutlier %>% .$avg_hr,
                                                sd_hr = df1_nooutlier$sd_hr
                                                )))),
                N_alpha = 5,
                N_beta = 5,
                N_lapse = 3,
                prediction = df1_nooutlier$prediction,
                
                Y = df1_nooutlier  %>% .$resp
                
)

## fitting
HRD_final <- mod$sample(
  data = datastan,
  iter_sampling = 2500,
  iter_warmup = 2500,
  chains = 4,
  init = 0,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 50,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 12
)
HRD_final$save_object(here::here("STAN models","HRD_final.RDS"))  

if(dir.exists(here::here("STAN models"))){
  HRD_double$save_object(here::here("STAN models","HRD_full.RDS"))  
}else{
  dir.create(here::here("STAN models"))
  HRD$save_object(here::here("STAN models","HRD.RDS"))
}

HRD_doublecontrol <- readRDS("~/Beta-Blocker_mine/STAN models/revisions/revisions_v2/HRD_final.RDS")

## Threshold
HRD_doublecontrol$summary(c("gm[2]","gm[3]"))
as_draws_df(HRD_doublecontrol$draws(c("gm[2]","gm[3]"))) %>% select(-contains(".")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>% group_by(name) %>% summarize(1-sum(value>0)/n(),
                                                              mean = mean(value),
                                                              q5 = hdi(value)[1],
                                                              q95 = hdi(value)[2])


## Slopes
HRD_doublecontrol$summary(c("gm[7]","gm[8]"))
as_draws_df(HRD_doublecontrol$draws(c("gm[7]","gm[8]"))) %>% select(-contains(".")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>% group_by(name) %>% summarize(1-sum(value>0)/n(),
                                                              mean = mean(value),
                                                              q5 = hdi(value)[1],
                                                              q95 = hdi(value)[2])

## Lapse rate
HRD_doublecontrol$summary(c("gm[12]","gm[13]"))
as_draws_df(HRD_doublecontrol$draws(c("gm[12]","gm[13]"))) %>% select(-contains(".")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>% group_by(name) %>% summarize(1-sum(value>0)/n(),
                                                              mean = mean(value),
                                                              q5 = hdi(value)[1],
                                                              q95 = hdi(value)[2])
```


### load data
```{r}
rrst = read.csv(here::here("data","RRST_trial_level_data.csv"))


drugguess_data <- read_csv(here::here("data","drugguess_data.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(drugs = ifelse(ActualDrug == "plac","PLACEBO",ifelse(ActualDrug == "biso","BISO","PROP")),
         subject = paste0("sub_",SubNo)) %>% 
  mutate(SubNo = NULL)



data <- inner_join(rrst,drugguess_data) %>%
  mutate(
    sub = as.numeric(as.factor(subject)),
    condition = as.numeric(drugs),
    BISO_vs_PLACEBO = case_when(
      drugs == "PLACEBO" ~ 0,
      drugs == "BISO" ~ 1,
      drugs == "PROP" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Use NA_real_ for numeric NA
    ),
    PROP_vs_PLACEBO = case_when(
      drugs == "PLACEBO" ~ 0,
      drugs == "BISO" ~ 0,
      drugs == "PROP" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Use NA_real_ for numeric NA
    ),
    
  ) %>%  mutate(trials = 1:n()) %>% 
  mutate(trials = 1:n()) %>% 
  mutate(prediction = ifelse(ActualDrug == GuessedDrug,1,0)) %>% 
  select(Resp, drugs, subject, sub, Stim, trials, BISO_vs_PLACEBO,PROP_vs_PLACEBO, ConfResp,RespLR,prediction) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(sub = as.numeric(as.factor(subject)))



```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}


# again 3 random responses and last unblinded
badids = c("sub_4024","sub_4077","sub_4072","sub_4049")


df1_remove_outlier = data %>% filter(!subject %in% badids)


df1_remove_outlier = df1_remove_outlier %>% mutate(sub = as.numeric(as.factor(sub))) %>%
  arrange(sub,drugs) %>% group_by(sub,drugs) %>%
  mutate(trials_per_id = 1:n()) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(full_trials = 1:n(), trials = NULL)

# write.csv(df1_remove_outlier,here::here("data","cleaned","RRST.csv"))


df1_remove_outlier = inner_join(avg_hr,df1_remove_outlier)


RRST = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("scripts","stanmodels","revisions","revisions_v2","RRST_final.stan"),stanc_options = list("O1"))

datastan = list(T = nrow(df1_remove_outlier),
                S = length(unique(df1_remove_outlier$sub)),
                S_id = (df1_remove_outlier$sub),
                X = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$Stim,
                X_lapse = t(as.matrix((data.frame(int = rep(1,nrow(df1_remove_outlier)),
                                                placebo_vs_biso = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$BISO_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                placebo_vs_prop = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$PROP_vs_PLACEBO)))),
                
                X_alpha = t(as.matrix((data.frame(int = rep(1,nrow(df1_remove_outlier)),
                                                placebo_vs_biso = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$BISO_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                placebo_vs_prop = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$PROP_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                avg_hr = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$avg_hr,
                                                sd_hr = df1_remove_outlier$sd_hr
                                                 )))),

                X_beta = t(as.matrix((data.frame(int = rep(1,nrow(df1_remove_outlier)),
                                                placebo_vs_biso = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$BISO_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                placebo_vs_prop = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$PROP_vs_PLACEBO,
                                                avg_hr = df1_remove_outlier %>% .$avg_hr,
                                                 sd_hr = df1_remove_outlier$sd_hr
                                                 )))),
                
                N_alpha = 5,
                N_beta = 5,
                N_lapse = 3,
                prediction = df1_remove_outlier$prediction,
                Y = df1_remove_outlier  %>% .$Resp
)

## fitting
RRST_control <- RRST$sample(
  data = datastan,
  iter_sampling = 2500,
  iter_warmup = 2500,
  chains = 4,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 50,
  init = 0,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 12
)
RRST_control$save_object(here::here("STAN models","RRST_final.RDS"))
```
